newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian Gold Index extremely oversold.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian Gold Index extremely oversold.

text.p: --------------Analysis by Daniel Fock - Jun 27--------------
*Continue lower to 1,450 target
*Leading indicators lower and oversold
*Traders remain cautious with trailing stops
*Gold index closed at 1,456.8 on Thursday
The Australian Gold Index is lower again, hitting the 1,450 target and the lowest level for almost five years.
Leading indicators are again lower.
Traders are likely to be tempted to look for a bottom, but likely to remain short, lower trailing stops, and be supremely cautious.
Short term techncials are bearish. The averages are bearish.
Leading indicators are lower and oversold.
The ROC is slightly higher off its low, and the Stochastics are bouncing at their bottoms.
There is some consolation in that, the index finised towards its high, albeit lower. Fibonacci retracements are 1,476, 1,486 and 1,496.
In the medium term, the index is lower towards the bottom of the bear channel.
This channel is contained by a potential large descending triangle, the boundaries of which are 1,415 and 2,025.
Traders are remaining short while the index falls, but are increasingly anxious about the growing possibility of a retracement.
Medium term technicals are bearish and very oversold.
Averages are bearish. Leading indicators are lower and oversold. The Stochastics are sidelined below 10, but slightly higher than last week.
Higher Fibonacci retracements are 1,656, 1,722, and 1,788.
In the longer term, the index continues lower within its bear corridor, and below last month's low.
Bears continue to focus on the head and shoulders formation, but with the oversold nature of the index, they too are likely to be cautious and move trailing stops closer to current levels.
There is a possible retest of the neckline at 1,700.
Longer term technicals are bearish and oversold. Averages remain bearish, leading indicators are losing bearish momentum, with the ROC and Stochastics slightly higher than last week.
The index will need to rally above 1,700 to concern the long term bears.
The index broke lower again, reaching its target of 1,450. There is an uneasiness growing, especially with the end of the financial year looming.
Leading indicators are lower and very oversold, so the chances of a retracement are growing.
Seasoned traders are likely to remain cautious and tighten trailing stops. Any retracement or bear market rally is likely to be dynamic, and without warning.
Traders have been waiting for a retracement for months, so expect it when they are all very comfortable being short.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own.)
-- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
